title: Module PSR-4 roots and relocation of the existing Scopes and Audit files
summary: `packages/core/composer.json` gains the PSR-4 roots `AzGuard\Scopes\ → modules/scopes/src/` and `AzGuard\Audit\ → modules/audit/src/` (`AzGuard\DevTools\ → modules/devtools/src/` with P3.7); every file under `src/Scopes`, `src/Audit`, `src/Plugins/Audit` and the module-owned files in core directories move to their oracle `target_path` (FQCN changes only where the oracle row says so); the core guarded-query classes move to `Authorization\Internal\Query`. I5 allowlist becomes empty.
why: One autoload owner per FQCN (I5) and the phase deliverable 'modules/scopes, modules/audit with explicit PSR-4 roots'. Hard risk: Composer resolves the longest prefix but falls back to `AzGuard\ → src/`; a leftover `src/Scopes/...` file would be loaded by the core root — the directories must be empty and deleted; and the path-repository install needs `composer update` before the new roots are visible.

include: `packages/core/composer.json` autoload psr-4 adds `AzGuard\\Scopes\\` and `AzGuard\\Audit\\` (knowledge/target-structure#core); `composer update axiomasoft/azguard axiomasoft/azguard-filament` per knowledge/p3-execution#commands

Relocate by oracle rows (procedure knowledge/p3-execution#moves): all of `src/Scopes/**` → `modules/scopes/src/**` (incl. `Scopes\RoleBindings` → `Scopes\Internal\RoleBindings`, `Scopes\Query\EligibilityBuilder` → `Scopes\Internal\Query\EligibilityBuilder`, P3.2 `FilterQuery`/`FilterGuard`), `Directories\QueryScopeDirectory` → `Scopes\Internal\QueryScopeDirectory`, `Contracts\Scopes\{AssignmentScopeAccessAdapter,AssignmentScopeFilter,AssignmentScopeMembership,ConfigurableAssignmentScopeDefinition}` → `Scopes\Contracts\*`; `src/Audit/**` → `modules/audit/src/**`; `Plugins\Audit\AuditPlugin` → `Audit\AuditPlugin`; `Plugins\Audit\AuditTableExists` → `Audit\Internal\Checks\AuditTableExists`
Core rows of the same area: `Scopes\Query\{PredicateBuilder,PredicateQuery,QueryGuard}` → `Authorization\Internal\Query\*` in `packages/core/src`

`src/Scopes`, `src/Audit`, `src/Plugins/Audit` deleted; i5.json emptied; moved allowlist paths updated; `tests/zones.json` gains the module roots (zone of their tests); `phpstan.neon`, `rector.php`, `pint.json`, `phpunit.xml` source paths include `packages/core/modules/*/src` where they list `packages/core/src`; `bin/api-manifest.php` covers module roots (manifests regenerated)
Migration lines for supported symbols that change FQCN: the four `Contracts\Scopes\*` module contracts, `Plugins\Audit\AuditPlugin`, `Directories\QueryScopeDirectory` (closed)
